title: 🛖 Privacy Hub - Privacy is Normal
description: We all practice privacy daily: Face ID, ATM PINs, hidden chats, VPNs, private browsers. In this interactive 20-minute talk, we surface these habits, then ask why we drop them onchain. Early blockchains promised anonymity but became fully transparent, with every balance and transaction traceable. We share practical, low-friction steps for IRL, offchain and onchain.
